references.text: The psalm describes how the righteous are mocked and ridiculed, which mirrors the treatment Jesus received from the religious leaders.
David speaks of how his enemies mock him, paralleling how Jesus was mocked.
Jesus predicts how he will be mocked by the religious leaders, a prophecy fulfilled in Matthew 27:41.
Luke describes a similar scene where Jesus is mocked while being crucified, showing a parallel event.
Mark gives a similar description of how the religious leaders mock Jesus on the cross.
